title: Synthesis of Ovarian Cancer Multi-Omics Datasets: A Biology-Informed Evaluation Framework
abstract: arXiv:2611.08394v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Paired multi-omic cancer cohorts are costly to assemble and difficult to share, motivating synthetic cohorts as a complementary resource. As generative model development accelerates, we shift the focus from proposing yet another architecture to defining evaluation criteria that determine whether synthetic data preserve biologically relevant structure. We introduce a biology-informed and patient-disjoint framework for evaluating the generation of paired RNA expression and copy-number variation (CNV) profiles, and apply it to the longitudinal DECIDER high-grade serous ovarian cancer cohort. The framework assesses modality-specific fidelity and coherence between RNA and CNV pairs using agreement between real training and held-out data as a reference, alongside complementary training-data proximity diagnostics. We adapt three multi-omic integration architectures based on variational autoencoders to generate paired profiles. The model leading

translated_title: 卵巢癌多组学数据集的合成：一种基于生物学的评估框架
translated_abstract: 配对的多组学癌症队列构建成本高昂且难以共享，这促使合成队列成为一种补充资源。随着生成模型开发的加速，我们将研究重点从提出又一种新架构转移到定义评估标准上，即确定合成数据是否保留了生物学相关的结构。我们引入了一个基于生物学信息且患者分离的评估框架，用于评估配对RNA表达和拷贝数变异（CNV）谱的生成效果，并将其应用于纵向DECIDER高级别浆液性卵巢癌队列。该框架以真实训练数据与保留数据之间的一致性作为参考，评估各模态的保真度以及RNA与CNV配对之间的连贯性，同时辅以训练数据邻近性等补充性诊断指标。我们改编了三种基于变分自编码器的多组学整合架构来生成配对数据。表现最优的模型……（摘要至此截断）
tldr: 本文的核心贡献是提出了一个基于生物学信息且患者分离的评估框架，用于判断合成的配对RNA表达与拷贝数变异数据是否保留了生物学相关结构，并将其应用于高级别浆液性卵巢癌DECIDER队列。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a biology-informed, patient-disjoint evaluation framework for assessing whether synthetic paired RNA expression and copy-number variation profiles preserve biologically relevant structure, applied to the DECIDER high-grade serous ovarian cancer cohort.
